about: What a GitHub Actions runner account on the VPS should and should not reach. scripts/vps/Check-RunnerIsolation.ps1 compares Get-RunnerFacts.ps1 output, the workflows and the repository's Actions settings against it. Issue #2161. No secret belongs here.
decision: Patrick, 11 Oct 2026, final (replaces the first write-up in #2295): GitHub-hosted runners are the default for builds; the VPS runners (productionLabel) are a backup only, by hand or automatically when hosted runs fail for lack of Actions minutes or usage. Codex lane owns that design and build.yml; release and Ship stay where they are unless it conflicts. The VPS runner accounts get outbound limits allowing only GitHub and the package feeds builds use (pypi.org, files.pythonhosted.org, registry.npmjs.org), a live step for Claude. docs/RUNNER-ISOLATION.md section 6.
